theme_central: A questioner defiantly demands the punishment already under way — answered by the cosmic scale of the Lord of the ways of ascent, then the portrait of the believers whose hearts are already turned toward that Day.

branches.title: The questioner, cosmic scale
branches.resume: A disbeliever defiantly demands the punishment; a Day equal to 50,000 years, patience recommended.

children.t: The questioner's defiance, a Day equal to 50,000 years

branches.title: Cosmic dissolution
branches.resume: The sky like molten metal, the mountains like carded wool, social bonds completely severed.

children.t: Sky melted, mountains scattered, social bonds severed, ransom refused

branches.title: Traits of the believers
branches.resume: Man is anxious and stingy by nature, except the constant worshippers: chastity, promises kept, prayer preserved.

children.t: Traits of true believers: chastity, trust kept, constant prayer

branches.title: Futile excuses, consolation
branches.resume: Futile excuses of the disbelievers on the Day of reckoning, final consolation addressed to the Prophet.

children.t: Futile excuses of the disbelievers, final consolation of the Prophet
